title: office.scribe-pending request
description: Parse one session transcript through the conversation adapter (text between the user and the agent only, credentials scrubbed) into <library>/.office/state/scribe/<session_id>.jsonl (the Library's git-ignored state), owner-only, and return what the scribe has not read yet. Model-free; no Library commit.

transcript.description: Transcript path inside the granted workspace or Library.

provider.description: Transcript format; only claude-code has an adapter.

cwd.description: The session's working directory; used to derive the project name when no resolved project is provided.

project.description: Optional caller-resolved repository name used as the SCR project and default topic; absent, the project is derived from the cwd basename.
